executive_summary.headline: Residual PSC burden fails release criteria — T4 disposition
executive_summary.detail: resipsc analysed 500 cells from batch DIAG-RERUN-001. 35 cells exceeded the PSC decision threshold (estimated fraction 6.9095%). Biomarker cross-check agreement was 95.0%. The dominant detected lineage is mesoderm.
executive_summary.caveat: This is a computational inference from scRNA-seq data. It does not replace orthogonal wet-lab release assays (HEC, ddPCR, flow cytometry) and has not been cleared by FDA or EMA.

regulatory_context.fda: 21 CFR 1271 (HCT/Ps): release testing for residual PSCs is required before administration of PSC-derived cell therapy products. resipsc supports release at observed residual PSC fraction <= 0.001% and recommends quarantine above 1%. 21 CFR 211 (cGMP) applies to more-than-minimally-manipulated PSC derivatives. 21 CFR Part 11: audit trail implemented as an append-only, SHA-256 hash-chained event log with UTC timestamps.
regulatory_context.ema: EMEA/CHMP/410869/2006 (Guideline on human cell-based medicinal products): requires identity, potency, purity, microbiological safety, viability and tumorigenicity testing. Purity criterion: residual undifferentiated cells below a sponsor-justified threshold; QP release is defensible at <= 0.001% with orthogonal confirmation.
regulatory_context.ich: ICH Q5E Comparability of Biotechnological/Biological Products: pre/post retrain concordance analysis (sensitivity/specificity/kappa). ICH Q9(R1) Quality Risk Management: formal FMEA covering input data quality, model failure modes and infrastructure. ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System: change control, CAPA, management review and knowledge management implemented around the model lifecycle.

disclaimer.primary: Research Use Only — NOT FDA-cleared. This report is a computational inference from single-cell RNA-seq data and does not constitute a clinical release test.
limitations: Model trained on a hybrid corpus (simulated multi-site data + real PBMC reference); clinical performance on therapeutic manufacturing batches is not yet established.
Detection limits below 0.001% PSC depend on sequenced cell count and depth; bootstrap CIs quantify this uncertainty.
Lineage assignment and teratoma site priors are literature-derived estimates, not patient-level predictions.
Batch effects, ambient RNA and doublets can inflate apparent PSC fractions; the biomarker cross-check mitigates but does not eliminate this.
No wet-lab orthogonal validation (HEC, ddPCR, lncRNA flow) has been performed for this build.
disclaimer.wet_lab_confirmation: Confirm any non-RELEASE disposition with an orthogonal assay: ddPCR for LIN28A/ESRG, immunostaining for OCT4/TRA-1-60, or the histological embryoid-body assay, per EMEA/CHMP/410869/2006.
disclaimer.decision_authority: The disposition code is a recommendation. Release authority rests with the Qualified Person under EMA rules or the responsible QA officer under FDA rules.
disclaimer.audit_trail: All model inputs, outputs and decisions are recorded in the append-only audit trail (db/audit.db).
